prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-sakkra-audience.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
4 · Sakkra — Sssla — jade green
Game role: the expansionist breeders. Strengths: explosive population growth, cheap planetology (terraforming). Weaknesses: strained relations with several races; poor diplomacy; need constant new land.
Body & dress: saurian: lean, long-necked, crested, fine overlapping olive/green scales with a darker dorsal ridge, yellow slit eyes, forked tongue; tail. Military harness over a dark high-collar tunic, bronze buckles, clan bands on the arm. Practical, aggressive.
Surroundings: steaming jungle-world architecture grown into the ship: humid corridors with condensation, moss-stained bulkheads, hatchery galleries with rows of warm incubator pods glowing amber-green, vines through rusty ironwork.
Personality: proud, impatient, prizes strength; hospitable only to the strong. Moods: restless menace → sneering disdain → hungry attention.
Hooks: egg-clutch tallies as status, a crowded nursery in the background, a hunting spear as a ceremonial staff.
Asset purpose: Diplomacy audience background. Create an imposing seat of power: audience hall, throne-office or war room derived from the race surroundings, with spatial depth and homeworld atmosphere.
Composition: No foreground characters: the game composites its existing leader portrait separately. Keep left 45% and bottom 30% dark and calm; architecture, windows, light and visual interest at centre-right.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
